$comment: Every *-city-atlas city, with a bbox, for the neighbourhood-boundary extraction. bbox is [minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat]. Sources: layer/registry-cities.json, src/data/atlas-city-centers.json, else a +/-0.25 deg fallback. This feeds the PBF pipeline in ayeeff/osm (extract_city_2d_data.py) run per country over the R2 extracts.

clusters.$comment: Cities are grouped by geography so a job cuts one compact region instead of scanning a whole country file per city. The plan job groups by (extract, cluster); the build step cuts the union bbox once and then each city from it.
